description: This file defines the EmailSubscriptionDao class, which manages email subscription data access, including retrieving, counting, and saving email notification entities within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmailSubscriptionDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for managing email subscription notifications, providing methods to retrieve, count, and save email notification entities.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of email notifications based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriptionList
methods.description: Returns a paginator object for email notifications matching the search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriptionListCount
methods.description: Returns the count of email notifications matching the search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriptionById
methods.description: Fetches a specific email notification by its ID.

methods.name: saveEmailSubscription
methods.description: Persists an email notification entity to the database.
